observed_steps: Logged in as the existing owner, super administrator, and a newly created ordinary user through the live Gateway at 127.0.0.1:8003.
Owner submitted a knowledge-base visibility application and super administrator approved it.
Ordinary user read the public knowledge base successfully (HTTP 200).
Owner changed the knowledge base back to private; ordinary user then received HTTP 404.
Owner resource and knowledge-revision responses did not contain provider_dataset_id.
evidence_scope: Live local Gateway and current knowledge-base records; credentials and tokens omitted.
